items.name: utils
items.title: cn and motion helpers
items.description: Class merging, reduced-motion detection, and one-time keyframe injection used by every Nexara component.

items.name: draggable-card
items.title: Draggable Card
items.description: A movable card with spring tilt, optional snap-back, a drag handle, and keyboard nudging. Also called a draggable or movable card.
items.usage:
import { DraggableCard } from '@/components/ui/draggable-card'

<DraggableCard bounds={stageRef} variant="elevated" snapBack={false}>
  Drag me
</DraggableCard>

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card whose highlight and hairline follow the pointer.
items.usage:
import { SpotlightCard } from '@/components/ui/spotlight-card'

<SpotlightCard className="p-6" spotlightColor="rgba(255, 106, 61, 0.45)">
  Follow the light
</SpotlightCard>

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: A responsive mosaic of spotlight tiles.
items.usage:
import { BentoGrid, BentoItem } from '@/components/ui/bento-grid'

<BentoGrid columns={3}>
  <BentoItem colSpan={2} title="Wide" description="Two columns." />
</BentoGrid>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Solid, outline, ghost, gradient, and shimmer buttons with loading and link modes.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: A button that leans toward a fine pointer.
items.usage:
import { MagneticButton } from '@/components/ui/magnetic-button'

<MagneticButton variant="outline" strength={20}>Come closer</MagneticButton>

items.name: aurora-background
items.title: Aurora Background
items.description: Drifting color fields with optional film grain.

items.name: grid-background
items.title: Grid Background
items.description: A dotted or ruled surface with an optional pointer-following fade.
items.usage:
import { GridBackground } from '@/components/ui/grid-background'

<GridBackground variant="dots" fade interactive className="min-h-64">{children}</GridBackground>

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient Text
items.description: Lettering clipped to an optional animated gradient.
items.usage:
import { GradientText } from '@/components/ui/gradient-text'

<GradientText>Night, gold, and iris.</GradientText>

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types and deletes a list of phrases.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Staggers words or characters into place when they enter the viewport.
items.usage:
import { TextReveal } from '@/components/ui/text-reveal'

<TextReveal as="h2" text="Arrive one word at a time." />

items.name: floating-navbar
items.title: Floating Navbar
items.description: A pill navigation bar that compacts on scroll and collapses into a menu.
items.usage:
import { FloatingNavbar } from '@/components/ui/floating-navbar'

<FloatingNavbar logo="Nexara" items={[{ label: 'Work', href: '/work', active: true }]} />

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: An accessible dialog with a focus trap, escape to close, and scroll locking.
items.usage:
import { Modal, ModalContent, ModalClose } from '@/components/ui/modal'

<Modal open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <ModalContent title="Edit name">
    <ModalClose>Close</ModalClose>
  </ModalContent>
</Modal>

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: A centered or split marketing intro with staggered entrance and slots for actions and media.
items.usage:
import { Hero } from '@/components/ui/hero'

<Hero align="split" eyebrow="New" title="A room with movable parts" description="Compose this freely." />

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite horizontal loop with edge fade and a pause control.
